name: sgs/cart
title: SGS Cart
description: WooCommerce mini-cart: live item-count badge plus an optional flyout (disclosure) or drawer (dialog) panel with AJAX add/qty/remove via the WooCommerce Store API. Hydrates client-side to bypass full-page cache.

badgeBackground.reason: The cart-icon badge is a status indicator nested inside .sgs-cart__trigger, not itself a click target — no :hover CSS targets it anywhere in style.css.

panelBackground.reason: The flyout/drawer panel surface is not a click target — its child close/view/checkout buttons carry their own separate colour attributes. No :hover CSS targets the panel background anywhere.

sgs._comment_mediaElements: The mini-cart item thumbnail (WooCommerce product image, hydrated client-side by panel-render.js/item-row-template.js from the Store API) routes its object-fit through the shared media-element atom layer. render.php (always PHP-rendered, even before JS hydration) emits the atom's --sgs-media-object-fit custom property scoped to the block wrapper; item-row-template.js appends the shared .sgs-media-el marker class to the thumbnail it builds at runtime — the custom property inherits down regardless of when that element is added to the DOM. style.css does not hardcode object-fit on .sgs-cart__item-thumb; it relies on assets/css/media-atoms/object-fit.css's cover fallback.

scrim.label: Backdrop / scrim
scrim._note: The shared viewport scrim (Wave 3C U-2, `includes/helpers-scrim.php::sgs_scrim_render`): the see-through layer printed at wp_footer that dims the page while this block's drawer, dialog or panel is open. Mapped here so the converter can route a draft's scrim colour, strength and blur to these attributes.

wrapper.label: Cart wrapper
wrapper._note: supports.color is explicitly {background:false,text:false} and spacing.padding is false — layout is scoped to margin only (every other layout member is a real gap, not a missing declaration).

icon.label: Cart icon
icon._note: iconSize is a real attribute but is not a css:font-size (sets width/height, not text size) — no cluster member exists, so it is an honest ORPHAN (FR-35-4). `css:stroke` (icon/SVG gradient mechanism) is explicit-mapped to iconColourGradient — non-empty wins over iconColour's flat currentColor paint at render time (helpers-svg-gradient.php). iconColourHover/iconColourHoverGradient mirror sgs/icon's own hover states shape exactly — resolved via sgs_icon_gradient_css() on .sgs-cart__trigger:hover.

badge.label: Item-count badge
badge._note: badgeColour/badgeTextColour do not follow the default {prefix}{suffix} convention — explicit attrMap required per ROLLOUT REQUIREMENT 1. Gradient siblings: badgeColourGradient paints a hand-built ::after layer (NOT sgs_block_background_layer_css() — the badge is already position:absolute, which that helper would silently override), freeing the element's own background-image for badgeTextColourGradient's background-clip:text. badgeTextColourHover/badgeTextColourHoverGradient are safe to paint directly on .sgs-cart__badge because the badge's own background always lives on its ::after layer, never on the badge element itself — background-clip:text on hover cannot clip a background that isn't there.

panel.label: Mini-cart panel
panel._note: FR-36-19 — the flyout/drawer panel surface. panelBg/panelTextColour do not follow {prefix}{suffix} — explicit attrMap. Only rendered when displayMode is flyout|drawer. Gradient siblings use the same hand-built ::after reasoning as the badge element above (the panel's own --flyout/--drawer modifiers declare position:absolute/fixed, at the same specificity a uid-scoped sgs_block_background_layer_css() rule would carry). panelTextColourHover/panelTextColourHoverGradient are safe for the same reason as the badge above — the panel's own background always lives on its ::after layer.

pill.label: Trigger pill (text style)
pill._note: Wave B — triggerStyle:'pill' swaps the icon+badge trigger for a word (pillLabel) beside the live item count, in a pill (matches a 'Bag'/'Cart' text trigger draft shape). Only rendered/styled when triggerStyle is 'pill' — the icon element above stays the trigger for triggerStyle:'icon' (the default). HAND-BUILT ::after for the background (same reasoning as badge/panel above: .sgs-cart__trigger is already position:relative in style.css, and a text gradient's background-clip:text must not be clipped by the pill's own fill) — pillTextColour styles the LABEL only; the count beside it keeps using the existing badgeTextColour/badgeTextColourGradient attributes (same badge element, restyled inline for the pill via CSS, so one colour control governs the count in both trigger styles). Border (compliance correction, Spec 35 §14/§1 field 9f): pillBorderWidth (box object, base only) + pillBorderStyle (enum) + pillBorderColour (flat, no gradient sibling) mount through `SgsBorderControl`, mirroring sgs/whatsapp-cta's cardBorderWidth/cardBorderStyle/cardBorderColour (card-fields.js CardTypographyPanel) — no ad-hoc second colour mechanism. pillBorderRadius stays the one exception: a plain CSS-length STRING (default '' — CSS default of border-radius:999px in style.css governs), NOT a responsive 4-corner tier object, per Spec 32 §6.1's deliberate-keep for a single uniform pill radius (mirrors sgs/option-picker's pillBorderRadius) — `SgsBorderControl`'s `onRadiusChange` pairing is typed for that 4-corner tier shape, so pairing this scalar there would force the very object migration §6.1 exempts; it is mounted immediately alongside the composite instead (PillBorderControl.js). `layout` cluster added (compliance pass) purely so css:border-color/css:border-width/css:border-style/css:border-radius — all members of that cluster, per scripts/consistency/cluster-member-sets.json — resolve against this element's own attrMap instead of reporting ORPHAN:STYLE-DEFECT; no other `layout` member (padding/margin/gap/etc.) has an attrMap entry here, so none of them are newly claimed.

freeDeliveryTrack.label: Free-delivery progress track
freeDeliveryTrack._note: Wave B — the empty background of the free-delivery progress bar in the mini-cart panel (flyout or drawer). Only rendered when a threshold (manual override or the WooCommerce free-shipping zone method's min_amount) resolves to a positive number; both empty hides the whole feature. Built entirely client-side (panel-render.js) against Store API cart totals — see render.php's data-free-delivery-* attributes on the block wrapper, which is the only part of this feature render.php can own (the panel BODY markup lives in the shared includes/helpers-cart-panel.php, outside this build's file scope). freeDeliveryMessage/freeDeliverySuccessMessage (the progress-bar's two text states, edited in PanelSettingsControls.js) are declared here as `contentAttrs` — the content half of this element, not a style attribute, following Spec 35's PLACEMENT model (THE ELEMENT MANIFEST §ContentAttrs).

freeDeliveryFill.label: Free-delivery progress fill
freeDeliveryFill._note: Wave B — the filled portion of the free-delivery progress bar, width driven live by a --sgs-cart-free-delivery-pct custom property (panel-render.js element.style.setProperty()) — a custom-property VALUE, never a raw style="width:..." declaration (Spec 32 FR-32-4; mirrors sgs/audio's --sgs-progress and sgs/before-after's --sgs-before-after-position).

iconColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the cart icon's stroke instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColour at render time.

iconColourHoverGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the cart icon's stroke on hover instead of a flat colour. Non-empty wins over iconColourHover at render time.

badgeTextColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of badgeTextColourHover. Non-empty wins over badgeTextColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

panelTextColourHoverGradient.description: Hover-state gradient sibling of panelTextColourHover. Non-empty wins over panelTextColourHover on :hover/:focus-visible.

scrimColour.description: Wave 3C U-2 (family M-14): the drawer's backdrop tint. Only painted in the drawer display mode; see includes/helpers-scrim.php.

triggerStyle.description: Wave B — 'icon' is the existing icon+badge trigger. 'pill' replaces the icon with an editable word (pillLabel) beside the live item count, in a pill shape.

pillBgColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the trigger pill's background via background-image. Non-empty wins over pillBgColour at render time.

pillTextColourGradient.description: CSS gradient string painting the pill label text via background-clip:text. Non-empty wins over pillTextColour at render time.

pillBorderWidth.description: Pill border width, base tier only (Spec 35 §14 — no per-device border width). Empty = the block's own CSS default (1px).

pillBorderStyle.description: Pill border style. '' = inherit the block's own CSS default (solid).

pillBorderRadius.description: CSS length (e.g. "999px" or "50%"). Empty uses style.css's own border-radius:999px default (fully rounded).

countPopAnimation.description: Wave B — whether the live item count plays a short scale animation when it increases. Always off under prefers-reduced-motion regardless of this setting.

freeDeliveryThresholdOverride.description: Wave B — manual override for the free-delivery threshold, in the store's currency major unit (e.g. "75"). Empty uses the WooCommerce free-shipping method's min_amount for the store's base-country shipping zone. Both empty hides the progress bar.
